packageRules.description: typescript-eslint refuses to run against TS 7.0, and vite-plugin-dts needs a separate shim for it. Drop this rule once typescript-eslint ships TS 7 support (typescript-eslint#10940).

`nix fmt` is the formatting authority and uses nixpkgs' prettier. Keeping this pin equal to that version stops the two from disagreeing (they format union types differently since 3.9). Bump both together.
